name: north_sydney

positive_controls.flood: NONE - no council or statewide ArcGIS flood layer covers North Sydney (council flood planning area is PDF-only; NSW Hazard/1 Flood Planning has 0 North Sydney features)

note: Council public ArcGIS Online org (portaladmin_nsy) exposes only LEP Land Zoning (FeatureServer/40) plus boundary/label layers. No flood, bushfire, heritage, height, FSR, ASS, landslip or foreshore-building-line layers. Council's LEP/flood web map is a proprietary SIS WebMap (https://webmap.northsydney.nsw.gov.au/siswebmap9.1/en-gb/PublicMap/NSCMAPS), not ArcGIS REST. Use state_fallback for heritage/FSR/height; flood must come from the PDF Floodplain Risk Management Study and Plan (flood control lots are listed on the s10.7 certificate). An empty flood result must never be read as not flood affected.
